reason: Version 2 is the most faithful because it keeps nearly every claim, qualifier and commitment intact. Version 1 drops 'targeted' and changes 'capture' to 'serve', and version 3 makes some commitments conditional ('we'd'), firms up the 'potential returns' claim and adds specifics like 'faster site' and 'more marketing'. Version 4 ranks last because it removes core claims ('structural' decline, 'where our brand performs best') and hardens 'potential returns' into 'should return more'.
